notes.title: Final release
notes.notes: [h3]Hello, friends. [/h3][p]I present to you the finale of the story about the Lucky Bastard. I have put a lot of effort and time into this project. Let me remind you that I am doing this alone and only thanks to your support.[/p][p]Enjoy the game.[/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FvdENzG.jpg"][/img]I would like to note that the game will still be refined. A gallery with 2K renders will be added. The music will be changed and some scenes and dialogues will be voiced.[/p]

notes.title: The final version will be available tomorrow.
notes.notes: [h3]                                            Hello everyone! [/h3][p]I would like to announce that the final release of the story will take place tomorrow. Thank you to [/p][p]everyone who supported us, wrote reviews, and simply played and waited. I'll say right away that I'm [/p][p]planning at least one addition to the story. You'll understand what it's about when you finish the game.[/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FkwV6Tg.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thanks again, without your support it would have been difficult for me to get to the end of this journey.[/p][p] You guys are the best[/p][p]-Dev.[/p]

notes.title: News about the final version
notes.notes: [p]I previously announced that I plan to release the final version of the game at the end of June, but Steam's Summer Sale is starting soon. Steam does not recommend switching from early access to the final version during the sale. Therefore, I would like to inform everyone that the final version will be released after the Summer Sale ends. Lucky Bastard will still be available in the Summer Sale with the “Early Access” label. [/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/Fuh3jpI.jpg"][/img]In the meantime, enjoy your favorite coffee at Kelly's[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]#SteamSummerSale #VN #NSFW[/p]

notes.title: Lucky Bastard update. Girls in pursuit of new sensations.
notes.notes:
Hey there, friends! I'm thrilled to share the next chapter of our story with you. Remember, the story is in your hands, with four unique paths unfolding based on your choices. 

Spanish, French, and simplified Chinese have been added.

The gallery will be ready soon, so you can stay tuned for updates.

notes.title: Lucky Bastard update.
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone here to present the Lucky Bastard update. 
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/d1sLtLxF/lisa-promo.png[/img]
Depending on your choices earlier in the game, you will be given several options to date Lisa. Also, you will have to make a choice to determine the fate of further relationships with Jill and Margo. 
Enjoy the game.

notes.title: Early access release. What's next?
notes.notes:
Lucky bastard was released on the 24th. During this time was collected a certain amount of feedback, which was studied . And in connection with this, I would like to tell you about the upcoming changes:

• Achievements will be added.
• Corrections in the translation of the text.
• The game's walkthrough map will be published so you can explore all the content.

If you notice any bugs in the game please report them in the game center Lucky bastard to solve the problem.

Clerik studio are working hard to bring you new and improved features. Follow our updates to stay up to date with the latest changes and improvements!

P.S. If you are still planning to buy the game, you better hurry up, because the 30% discount associated with the release of the game will soon end.
